blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Sandiganbayan Third Division on Wednesday summoned Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) officials following claims that former House Speaker Martin Romualdez is leaving his jail cell. The Third Division is handling Romualdez’s plunder case stemming from alleged kickbacks from infrastructure projects worth P7.44 billion. According to Third Division clerk of court Dennis Pulma, the court ordered Jail Superintendent Maria Lourdes Pacion and medical officer Henry Fabro, both from the BJMP City Jail-Male Dormitory, to appear for a hearing on Thursday.
